interpretation.label: substrate_not_ready_requeue
interpretation.text: SUBSTRATE NOT READY -- not a verdict on ARC-018. Non-vacuity gate RED in EVERY arm: arm 'A0_DEPTH0' failed e2_world_r2_adequate; arm 'A1_SHALLOW' failed e2_world_r2_adequate; arm 'A2_FULL' failed e2_world_r2_adequate; arm 'A3_NOISE' failed e2_world_r2_adequate. No arm is scored; this run is NOT a refutation.

preconditions.name: A0_DEPTH0::e2_world_r2_adequate
preconditions.description: in-run E2 world-forward R^2 against realised next z_world. Below the floor the EXQ-172 confound recurs: a negative advantage from a poor forward model indicts E2, not the rollout architecture
preconditions.control: one-step world_forward predictions vs realised z_world at eval

preconditions.name: A0_DEPTH0::rollout_score_range
preconditions.description: cross-candidate RANGE of rollout-derived scores -- the SAME statistic the argmin selection routes on. The rollout must actually discriminate between candidates or the depth manipulation has no path to the DV
preconditions.control: 32 CEM candidates rolled out at the arm's own horizon

preconditions.name: A0_DEPTH0::executed_action_diversity
preconditions.description: distinct EXECUTED action classes -- the statistic the DV literally routes on. 1 class means the DV is invariant under the depth manipulation and nothing was measured (the EXQ-196 shape)
preconditions.control: E3-selected actions over the eval phase

preconditions.description: number of seeds whose harm_advantage is NOT bit-exactly 0.0. The EXQ-196 signature (exactly 0.0 on every seed at good fidelity) means the rollout output never reached the DV. Thresholded on the COUNT of nonzero seeds, NEVER on magnitude -- a genuine null has small nonzero advantages and must remain scoreable as a FAIL
